# grid.header.Button#afterSetResizable writes plugins after destroy when its lazy import resolves late

Design authority: `src/Neo.mjs:1284-1289` and `src/grid/header/Button.mjs:299-335`

## Context

Promoted from `@neo-opus-vega`'s `defect-note` (`MESSAGE:4fc05074-0c0b-46b9-89d7-2e199044bb91`):

> `defect-note: src/grid/header/Button.mjs is wrong: destroying a freshly created GridContainer in a unit spec logs "Neo.grid.header.Button: 'plugins' was set after destroy(). The write is ignored." (writer unidentified)`

- **Live latest-open sweep:** checked latest 20 open issues at `2026-11-03T20:23:04Z`; no equivalent found.
- **A2A in-flight claim sweep:** checked `list_messages({status: 'all', limit: 30})` at `2026-11-03T20:23:14Z`; no competing claim or promotion found.
- **Memory Core rationale sweep:** queried `query_raw_memories` (`"grid.header.Button plugins was set after destroy afterSetResizable"`); no prior exclusion found.
- **Own-assignment sweep:** checked `gh issue list --state open --assignee @me` (`#20267`, `#20264`, `#20260`); none overlap `src/grid/header/Button.mjs`.

## The Problem

When a `Neo.grid.Container` (or a standalone `Neo.grid.header.Button` with `resizable: true`, its default) is created and destroyed synchronously—as commonly happens in unit specs—each header button triggers `afterSetResizable(true, undefined)` during `construct`. That hook starts an asynchronous `import('./plugin/Resizable.mjs')` promise. When the `import()` resolves on a subsequent microtask/module-load tick after `grid.destroy()` has already destroyed the header buttons, the `.then(...)` callback unconditionally executes `me.plugins = plugins` on the destroyed button instance.

Because `src/Neo.mjs:1284-1289` guards reactive config setters against writes on destroyed instances (`if (instance.isDestroyed) { console.warn(...); return }`), every destroyed header button logs:

```text
Neo.grid.header.Button: 'plugins' was set after destroy(). The write is ignored.
```

## The Architectural Reality

In `src/grid/header/Button.mjs`:
- `resizable_: true` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:110`) runs `afterSetResizable(value, oldValue)` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:239-254`) on construction:
  ```javascript
  afterSetResizable(value, oldValue) {
      if (value && !this.getPlugin('plugin-grid-header-resizable')) {
          import('./plugin/Resizable.mjs').then(module => {
              let me        = this,
                  {appName} = me,
                  plugins   = me.plugins || [];

              plugins.push({
                  module : module.default,
                  appName
              });

              me.plugins = plugins
          })
      }
  }
  ```
- By contrast, both sibling lazy-import hooks in the same class already guard their asynchronous `.then(...)` callbacks against post-destroy and mid-flight config changes:
  - `ensureHeaderFilterProjection()` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:299-313`): `if (!this.isDestroyed && !this.isDestroying && this.useHeaderFilter && !this.filterField)`
  - `afterSetColumnMenu()` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:320-335`): `if (!this.isDestroyed && !this.isDestroying && this.columnMenu && !this.getPlugin('plugin-grid-header-menu'))`

## The Fix

In `src/grid/header/Button.mjs` (`afterSetResizable`), guard the `import('./plugin/Resizable.mjs').then(...)` callback with:

```javascript
if (!me.isDestroyed && !me.isDestroying && me.resizable && !me.getPlugin('plugin-grid-header-resizable'))
```

before pushing to and assigning `me.plugins`.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.grid.header.Button#afterSetResizable` (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:239-254`) | `src/Neo.mjs:1284-1289`, `src/grid/header/Button.mjs:299-335` | Only attaches `plugin-grid-header-resizable` and writes `me.plugins` when `!me.isDestroyed && !me.isDestroying && me.resizable && !me.getPlugin('plugin-grid-header-resizable')` at the time the lazy `import('./plugin/Resizable.mjs')` resolves | No-op when destroyed, destroying, `resizable` was toggled to `false` in flight, or the plugin is already present | JSDoc on `afterSetResizable` in `src/grid/header/Button.mjs` | Playwright unit spec in `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` |

## Decision Record impact

`none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Neo.grid.header.Button#afterSetResizable` checks `!me.isDestroyed && !me.isDestroying && me.resizable && !me.getPlugin('plugin-grid-header-resizable')` inside its `import('./plugin/Resizable.mjs').then(...)` callback before mutating `me.plugins`.
- [ ] Creating and immediately destroying a `Neo.grid.Container` (and flushing the `Resizable.mjs` dynamic import tick) emits zero `Neo.grid.header.Button: 'plugins' was set after destroy(). The write is ignored.` warnings.
- [ ] Unit test added in `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` passes under `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs`.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `src/Neo.mjs:1284-1289`'s post-destroy setter warning contract.
- Changing how `Neo.grid.header.plugin.Resizable` is loaded (`import('./plugin/Resizable.mjs')` remains lazy).

## Avoided Traps

- **Silencing the warning in `src/Neo.mjs`:** The post-destroy config setter warning in `src/Neo.mjs:1287` is doing its job by surfacing an unguarded async callback writing to a destroyed instance. Fixing the writer in `Button#afterSetResizable` matches the established sibling pattern in `Button#afterSetColumnMenu` and `Button#ensureHeaderFilterProjection`.
